text: [117] pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgatā bhikkhunī yathābhataṃ nikkhittā evaṃ niraye katamehi pañcahi ananuvicca apariyogāhetvā avaṇṇārahassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati ananuvicca apariyogāhetvā vaṇṇārahassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati issukinī ca hoti maccharinī ca saddhādeyyañca 1 vinipāteti . imehi kho .pe. pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgatā bhikkhunī yathābhataṃ nikkhittā evaṃ sagge katamehi pañcahi anuvicca pariyogāhetvā avaṇṇārahassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati anuvicca pariyogāhetvā vaṇṇārahassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati anissukinī ca hoti amaccharinī ca saddhādeyyañca 1 na vinipāteti . imehi kho .pe.
